issues.title: Circular/Structural-only ACs for Tracker Content
issues.why: AC-01 through AC-08 only verify file existence and banners; they do not verify that the 'Findings' (the actual output) follow the R/C/F/P schema defined in the overview.
issues.fix: Add an AC-AI-14 verifying that every finding in 02-consolidated-audit-findings contains the 4 mandatory sections and a valid severity label.

issues.title: Truncated Evidence in Consolidated Findings
issues.why: The primary output file (02-consolidated-audit-findings) is truncated in the spec, leaving the auditor with an incomplete list of findings (F-04 is cut off).
issues.fix: Ensure the full list of 24 findings is present or split into multiple files to avoid context window truncation.

issues.title: Unaddressed Schema Validation for Issue Records
issues.why: The spec provides a JSON schema for issue records but lacks a 'Verifies' clause or test case showing how a malformed record is rejected by the linter.
issues.fix: Add a 'Negative Case' example to 01-phase-2-git-logs-audit showing a schema validation failure.
